subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

One should enjoy __liberty__ with duties in mind.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. **'Freedom'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the underlined word is **'liberty',** which means the state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions by authorities.(स्वतंत्रता)

 
 
• **For example:** Every citizen has the right to liberty under the law.
 
 
 
• The synonym of 'Liberty' that matches in this context is **'Freedom',**(आज़ादी).
 
 
• **For example:** Freedom of expression is a fundamental human right.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is - 'Option 4' i.e.** 'Freedom'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Meal(भोजन)
 
• Democracy(लोकतंत्र)
 
• Statue (मूर्ति)
